episodes.title: No Shortcuts
episodes.summary: After a wild night in Vegas, Lucky wakes up to discover her world has been turned upside down.

episodes.title: Make 'em Dance
episodes.summary: Seeking shelter, Lucky takes refuge with an unsuspecting family. Priscilla visits Lucky's father.

episodes.title: Read the Room
episodes.summary: Lucky tries to track down Cary—and her money. Agent Rand investigates Lucky's moves.

episodes.title: Too Close to See It
episodes.summary: As Lucky confronts betrayal, old grudges take a back seat to a deadly chase.

episodes.title: Are We Bad People?
episodes.summary: On the run again, Lucky makes a lucrative discovery. Agent Rand devises a plan.

episodes.title: Wherever You Go, There You Are
episodes.summary: Lucky must face her past while planning for her future.

episodes.title: All Good Things
episodes.summary: Season finale. Everything is on the line as Lucky navigates an explosive confrontation.
